🦅 TIL: Northern #gannets and #boobies dive into the #sea at speeds over 110 km/h (68 mph) to catch #fish. 

A University of #Washington study found that these #birds have sturdier, squarer neck #vertebrae than other birds, plus an extra contact surface on several vertebrae that stops the neck from bending backward on impact.
